    To this end, we propose µVLM, the first VLM designed        • Model Design. We propose µVLM, the first multi-
specifically for µNPU platforms to perform real-time image        modal image captioning framework designed for low-
captioning. The design of µVLM prioritizes a lightweight          power µNPU platforms. Our lightweight NPU-friendly
architecture and minimal footprint, achieved through the          attention mechanisms enable the OverMod encoder and
co-design of its encoder and decoder. This approach ensures       AttSSM decoder to perform synergistic and adaptive
both high-quality semantic feature extraction and effective       vision-language alignment. µVLM not only adheres to
vision-language alignment, while maximizing hardware ac-          the stringent memory and operator constraints of µNPUs
celeration by leveraging NPU-friendly operations.                 but also exhibits competitive performance on the preva-
    Specifically, for the encoder, we propose OverMod, a          lent captioning dataset (CIDEr: 117.8).

rapidly scans the entire image to generate a global seman-        forms, encompassing a coordinated full-model quantiza-
tic context prior, and ModNet, which adaptively extracts          tion strategy and hardware-aware custom operator design.
image features under the guidance of this context. Mod-           These methods collectively enable the reliable deploy-
